pr_title: Fix snapping lines don't disappearing after drag anchors

issue_context.title: Axis Red lines don't get removed and persist in every scene
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

4.2.2.stable

### System information

Godot v4.2.2.stable - Windows 10.0.22631 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.5222) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-9700 CPU @ 3.00GHz (8 Threads)

### Issue description

So I came across a bug where if you try to move the anchors it creates red lines that don't go away and persist in every scene. This can be very frustrating as I have not encountered a way to fix this. 
![image_2024-05-26_132726718](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/57779109/6e3d3c7a-7be9-418a-a78d-f7bc095df127)
![image_2024-05-26_132741052](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/57779109/6a815c31-8677-454e-ba5c-c96fde67e0c7)


### Steps to reproduce

- Move anchor to center of button, image, any kind of gui
- Red lines show up and don't disappear

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
comments:
Tested with 4.0.3,stable, 4.2.2.stable and latest master v4.3.beta.custom_build [be56cab58] and i can confirm the problem, as workaround the red lines dissapear if you drag any node a bit (even if you drag a node in another scene)


https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/44306054/ddc23f00-69b9-4bb4-bb4d-48763bf92e00
Is this gonna be fixed in a newer version?
Is there a version with this fixed?

@Necrosis000 Please don't bump issues without contributing significant new information. We can't give an ETA on when the issue will be resolved as we don't know what's causing it in the first place.

As a workaround, set **Editors > 2D > Smart Snapping Guide Color** to a fully transparent color in the Editor Settings.
This still seems to be a valid issue based on @matheusmdx's testing, so it shouldn't be closed until it's solved.
